svg.title: Penile mid-shaft section
svg.desc: Paired corpora cavernosa and their tunica lie dorsally; corpus spongiosum surrounds the ventral urethra. Dorsal vessels and nerves are shown near Buck's fascia. Relative positions are schematic; vessel number and branching vary. The mapped imaging study concerns hypospadias, so normal-adult anatomical validation is still open. View: Male penis, transverse section; dorsal up. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: Kureel et al.: surgical anatomy of the penis in hypospadias (2015 MRI and surgical correlation), https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25917735/; access: abstract checked; Tissue-plane relationships in 12 hypospadias patients aged 8–20. Limited support for a generalized adult cross-section; normal-adult dissection review remains open. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.
